Enforce network segmentation and security policies between corporate and manufacturing networks. Support the company's readiness for compliance frameworks at the site level. Manage day-to-day relationships with local IT vendors, installers, and MSPs; escalate to the Senior IT Manager on contracts and larger commitments. Partner with the Burlingame IT System Administrator to keep corporate systems, security, and identity infrastructure aligned across sites. Preferred Qualifications Prior IT experience at a manufacturing, industrial, or plant site. Experience standing up IT infrastructure at a greenfield facility.
